issue: Under 18 U.S.C. § 4241, which party bears the burden of proof at a federal competency-to-stand-trial hearing?

sides.position: The burden of proof at a § 4241 competency hearing rests on the defendant (the party asserting incompetence). The excerpts do not identify which circuits hold this position.
The burden of proof at a § 4241 competency hearing rests on the government. The excerpts do not identify which circuits hold this position.

quote: I write separately because I believe the circuit split is misguided.
cite: United States v. Steven Michael Marks, No. 23-10463 (11th Cir. 2025)
